title: 第6章  韩素雪上眼药
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
韩素雪恨极了独孤静，不要脸的魔女，贱人！她居然勾引了大师兄，还生了大师兄的孩子，贱人！这贱人和她生下的小贱种，是大师兄的污点。
每一次看到谢莲心，她都恨不得将谢莲心碎尸万段了。
“烟儿是个懂事的好孩子，不需要人担心。不过，莲心这孩子，师兄恐怕得多多看顾着点了。”韩素雪道。
“师妹何出此言？”谢逸蹙起眉头来。
“这孩子啊，也十四了，见了我，居然连喊人都不会。我是她师叔，自然不会怪罪她，以后见了别人也如此，少不得要说她目中无人。”韩素雪道。
谢逸一听，眉头锁得越紧了。
“师兄知道她跟逍遥宫的苏珩走得近吗？”韩素雪又说。
谢逸露出诧异：
“苏珩？”
“是的，我见她跟苏珩走得挺近的。虽说明玉仙君素有名声，是个正人君子，只是……毕竟他不是玄天宗之人。跟外人走得太近，终归不好。师兄还是提点她一下，让她知道些轻重。”
“这孩子也大了，今日见了她，已经出落得亭亭玉立。女儿家大了，心思就难免多了。”
韩素雪话中有话，她见谢逸剑眉紧锁，脸若寒霜，就知道自己目的达到了。
“我便不妨碍师兄清修了，小妹日后再来。”
她说着站起身。
谢逸道：“如烟，送送你师叔。”
“是。”
柳如烟起身去送韩素雪。
她们二人走了之后，谢逸凭栏而立，看着水中的莲花，心思浮动。韩素雪说的有些话他不中意听，但是又难免多想。毕竟他的女儿确实大了，十四岁，这个年纪若是凡人，就该开始谈婚论嫁了……
而那个苏珩，很有女人缘。
————

谢莲心一回到玉阳峰就被谢逸喊去了。
“师尊，你找我啊。”谢莲心道。
谢逸坐在大殿的屏风前面，他示意谢莲心坐下。谢莲心在他对面坐下，疑惑地看着他。
“有事情吗？”谢莲心努力地想了想，自己没干坏事啊？
“刚刚你韩师叔来过。”谢逸道。
谢莲心：“……”
那女人好贱啊，居然跑来这里嚼舌头，谢莲心心里骂骂咧咧，但脸上不表露半分出来。
“哦，韩师叔说什么了？”
“你为何不跟你韩师叔打招呼？”谢逸问。
“冤枉啊，我哪里没跟师叔打招呼了？我就是反应比较慢而已，刚要喊人，师叔她就不高兴了。”谢莲心做出委屈巴巴的样子。
谢逸见了这委屈的小模样，顿时也觉得自己那师妹真是小题大做了。
“那你跟苏珩怎么回事？”谢逸问。
这打招呼的事情，实际上他不怎么关心，但是苏珩这事情，他很关心。
“明玉仙君？我今天才刚认识他的，怎么了？”
“今天才认识？”谢逸有点诧异。
“对啊，我今天才认识他呢。”
“你们怎么认识的？”
谢莲心就将事情经过说了，然后还将那炼金傀儡的灵力回路草稿拿出来给谢逸看。谢逸一看就入迷了，谢莲心还在旁边说：
“我之前看了师尊你留在书房里面的炼金手札，我觉得这灵力回路还能再优化一下，于是就自己试试看。”
谢逸盯着那图纸震惊不已：

“这、这都是你研究出来的。”
“嗯。”谢莲心点点头。
谢逸心中震惊，虽然知道女儿跟自己一样聪明，但她毕竟还小呢，没想到她这么出人意料。
“很了不起的想法，这个应该能行得通，只是以你的实力要炼制出来，怕是不可能。”谢逸道。
“我成功了。”
谢莲心道。
“什么？”
谢逸以为自己听错了。
谢莲心一挥手，手上多了一个人偶，精致的人偶。她将那人偶一扔，人偶落地，就从巴掌大小，变成了等人的尺寸了。
穿着樱花色衣裙的少女长发及腰，明眸善睐，她脸上带着微笑，朝着谢逸一拜，婉转地开口拜道：“属下晚樱见过尊上！”
不再是空洞麻木的人偶，宛如真人一般，而且还具有大乘期的实力。这傀儡若是一出，定然震惊世人。
现在谢逸都震惊了，他看着谢莲心：“你、你……”
谢莲心笑着说：“我确实炼制不出来，所以就拿师尊炼制的半成品试了试。我只是改了灵力回路，没想到还真能成功了。”
说着她手中出现了一团光芒，那团棕黄色的光芒变成了一个大大的盒子。盒子
一个个栩栩如生的人偶。这些人偶实际上都是谢逸炼制的炼金傀儡，是没有完成的半成品。
这些都还没有刻画上灵力回路，被搁置在了谢逸的璇玑宝库里面。
谢莲心知道自己的实力炼制能承受大乘期力量的身体她造不出来，所以她拿了谢逸炼制的半成品，刻上了自己创新的灵力回路。
谢逸心中的震惊不减，就算是拿他炼制的半成品做的，也够令人惊讶了。刚刚谢莲心那手稿，只是核心部分。
这大乘期傀儡体内有无数的灵力回路，要用神识和法力将这灵力回路刻画上去，对力量的控制必须达到臻至完美的境界。
错一处，就失败了，整个傀儡就废了。

就是得道的仙人也未必能成功将这傀儡造出来。
“我厉害吧！”谢莲心特嘚瑟。
谢逸唇角微微上扬起：“难为你了。”
“那这些人偶都给我练手了，可以吗？”谢莲心问。
谢逸哭笑不得：“你都拿了，还来问我？”
“先斩后奏嘛。”谢莲心笑嘻嘻地说，她一招手，晚樱身体缩小，变成一道粉色光芒落入盒子里，重新变成傀儡。
“师尊，我还有另一个灵力回路设想。”谢莲心说着又拿出了一副卷轴，卷轴铺开之后，上面都是密密麻麻又工整的灵力回路。
谢逸拿起看了几眼，就震惊不已：“这是……”
“这是简化过的，实力虽然会差一些，可能也笨一下，但是能够大量生产。如果能大量制作，推广的话，一定能对整个仙盟起大作用。”谢莲心说。
谢逸仔细研究了一下，再次震惊，这简化版的傀儡术若是制作出来能有合体期水平，虽然比不上大乘期的傀儡，但能大规模制作的话，整个仙盟的实力都能提升一一大截，这是功德无量啊。
“莲心，这也是你自己想的吗？”谢逸带着激动问道。
谢莲心点点头。
“你立了大功劳。”谢逸道看着眼前女儿，骄傲之感，油然而生，“若能大量生产这种傀儡，日后能大大减少仙盟的损伤。你想要什么奖励？”
“奖励，我不要奖励，能给师尊派上用场，那就太好了。”谢莲心笑着说。
一旦大规模推广，所有人的傀儡都会变成她的暗桩。她能随时随地，夺走傀儡的控制权，甚至让它们击杀它们本来的主人。
想想暗爽。
content_en:
Han Suxue hated Dugujing so much, she was a shameless witch and a bitch! She actually seduced her senior brother and gave birth to his child, bitch! This bitch and the little bitch she gave birth to are a stain on the elder brother.
Every time she saw Xie Lianxin, she wanted to cut Xie Lianxin into pieces.
"Yan'er is a sensible and good child. No one needs to worry. However, senior brother may need to take more care of Lian Xin," Han Suxue said.
"Why did junior sister say this?" Xie Yi frowned.
"This child is fourteen years old. When she saw me, she didn't even know how to call out. I am her uncle, so naturally I won't blame her. I will do the same when I see others in the future. I will definitely say that she is arrogant." Han Suxue said.
When Xie Yi heard this, his brows furrowed even more tightly.
"Does senior brother know that she is close to Su Heng from Xiaoyao Palace?" Han Suxue asked again.
Xie Yi was surprised:
"Su Heng?"
"Yes, I saw that she was very close to Su Heng. Although it means that Lord Yuxian has a reputation and is a gentleman, but... after all, he is not from Xuantian Sect. It is not good to be too close to outsiders. Senior brother should give her some advice and let her know the importance."
"This child is getting older too. When I saw her today, she has become a beautiful girl. As my daughter's family grows, she will inevitably have more worries."
There was something in Han Suxue's words. When she saw Xie Yi's eyebrows furrowed and his face as cold as frost, she knew that she had achieved her goal.
"I won't hinder senior brother's Qing Cultivation. My little sister will come back in the future."
She said and stood up.
Xie Yi said: "Ruyan, give it to your uncle."
"Yes."
Liu Ruyan got up and went to see Han Suxue off.
After the two of them left, Xie Yi stood on the railing and looked at the lotus flowers in the water, his mind wandering. He didn't like hearing some of what Han Suxue said, but he couldn't help but think more about it. After all, his daughter is indeed older, she is fourteen years old. If she were a mortal at this age, she should start talking about marriage...
And that Su Heng is very feminine.
————
As soon as Xie Lianxin returned to Yuyang Peak, she was called away by Xie Yi.
"Master, you are looking for me." Xie Lian said in her heart.
Xie Yi sat in front of the screen in the main hall, and he motioned for Xie Lianxin to sit down. Xie Lianxin sat down opposite him and looked at him doubtfully.
"Is there something wrong?" Xie Lianxin thought hard, did she not do anything bad?
"Your Uncle Han was here just now." Xie Yi said.
Xie Lianxin: "..."
That woman is so mean, she actually came here to chew her tongue. Xie Lianxin cursed in her heart, but she didn't show it on her face.
"Oh, what did Uncle Han say?"
"Why don't you say hello to your Uncle Han?" Xie Yi asked.
"It's unfair. Didn't I say hello to my uncle? I just reacted slowly. Just when I was about to call someone, my uncle became unhappy." Xie Lianxin looked aggrieved.
Seeing this aggrieved look, Xie Yi suddenly felt that his junior sister was really making a fuss out of a molehill.
"Then what's going on between you and Su Heng?" Xie Yi asked.
In fact, he didn't care much about the greeting, but he was very concerned about Su Heng.
"Mingyu Immortal Lord? I just met him today. What's wrong?"
"We just met today?" Xie Yi was a little surprised.
"Yes, I just met him today."
"How did you meet?"
Xie Lianxin told Xie Yi what happened, and then took out the draft of the alchemy puppet's spiritual power circuit to show to Xie Yi. Xie Yi was fascinated as soon as he saw it. Xie Lianxin was still beside him and said:
"I read the alchemy notes that Master left in your study before. I felt that the spiritual power circuit could be further optimized, so I gave it a try myself."
Xie Yi stared at the drawing and was shocked:
"This, this is all what you researched."
"Yeah." Xie Lianxin nodded.
Xie Yi was shocked. Although he knew that his daughter was as smart as himself, she was still young after all. He didn't expect her to be so unexpected.
"What a great idea. This should work. It just needs to beIt may be impossible to refine your strength. "Xie Yi said.
"I succeeded. "
Xie Lian thought.
"What? "
Xie Yi thought he heard wrongly.
Xie Lianxin waved her hand, and there was an exquisite doll in her hand. She threw the doll away, and when it hit the ground, it changed from the size of a palm to the size of a human being.
The girl in a cherry blossom-colored dress had long hair reaching her waist and bright eyes. With a smile on her face, she bowed to Xie Yi and said politely: "My subordinate Wan Ying has met your Majesty! "
He is no longer an empty and numb doll, he looks like a real person, and he also has the strength of the Mahayana stage. If this puppet were to appear, it would definitely shock the world.
Now Xie Yi was shocked. He looked at Xie Lianxin: "You, you..."
Xie Lianxin said with a smile: "I really couldn't refine it, so I tried it with the semi-finished product refined by Master. I just changed the spiritual circuit, but I didn't expect it to be successful. "
As she spoke, a ball of light appeared in her hand, and the brown light turned into a big box. box
Each lifelike doll. These puppets are actually alchemy puppets refined by Xie Yi, and are unfinished semi-finished products.
These have not been engraved with spiritual power circuits, and have been placed in Xie Yi's Xuanji treasure house.
Xie Lianxin knew that she could not create a body that could withstand the power of the Mahayana period due to her own strength, so she took the semi-finished product refined by Xie Yi and carved her own innovative spiritual circuit.
The shock in Xie Yi's heart did not diminish. Even if it was made from the semi-finished product he refined, it was surprising enough. The manuscript I thanked Lianxin just now is only the core part.
There are countless spiritual power circuits in the body of this Mahayana stage puppet. To use spiritual consciousness and magic power to carve these spiritual power circuits, the control of power must reach the state of perfection.
If you make one mistake, you will fail and the whole puppet will be useless.
Even an enlightened immortal may not be able to successfully create this puppet.
"I'm awesome! "Xie Lian was very worried.
The corners of Xie Yi's lips raised slightly: "It's hard for you. "
"Then these puppets are all for me to practice with, okay? "Xie Lianxin asked.
Xie Yi didn't know whether to laugh or cry: "You've already taken it, and you still come to ask me? "
"Behead first and show later. Xie Lianxin said with a smile. She waved her hand, and Wanying's body shrank, turned into a pink light and fell into the box, turning into a puppet again.
"Master, I have another idea for a spiritual power circuit. Xie Lianxin said and took out another scroll. After the scroll was spread out, it was covered with dense and neat spiritual power circuits.
Xie Yi picked it up and took a few glances, and was shocked: "This is..."
"This is simplified. Although it may be a little less powerful and may be a little stupider, it can be mass-produced. If it can be mass-produced and promoted, it will definitely have a great effect on the entire Immortal Alliance. "Xie Lianxin said.
Xie Yi studied it carefully and was shocked again. If this simplified version of the puppet technique can be produced to the level of the Fusion stage, although it is not as good as the puppets of the Mahayana stage, if it can be produced on a large scale, the strength of the entire Immortal Alliance can be greatly improved. This is a great merit.
"Lian Xin, is this what you think too? Xie Yi asked with excitement.
Xie Lianxin nodded.
"You have done a great job. "Xie Yidao looked at his daughter in front of him, feeling proud, "If this kind of puppet can be mass-produced, the damage to the Immortal Alliance can be greatly reduced in the future. What reward do you want? "
"Reward, I don't want a reward, it would be great if it can be put to use by Master. "Xie Lianxin said with a smile.
Once promoted on a large scale, everyone's puppets will become her backbone. She can take away control of the puppets anytime, anywhere, and even make them kill their original masters.
It feels so good to think about it.
